title: ED files chargesheet against EaseMyTrip promoter Nishant Pitti in Mahadev betting app case
description: Pitti, on behalf of the promoters of NzVs Easy Trip Planners Ltd., entered into a pre-arranged stock price manipulation deal with Amardeep Sharma to artificially inflate the share price and market capitalisation of IWs Easy Trip Planners Ltd., the chargesheet filed in a special PMLA court says
